text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A and Stock E after gains, sometimes in several small trades; I should avoid reacting to a quick rise and make sell decisions according to a clear plan.","Realizing gains did not stop my account value from declining, so I should assess the performance and risk of my whole portfolio rather than focus on individual winning trades.","I sold Stock E and Stock D at large losses after holding them as they fell; I should review losing positions consistently and decide whether to keep them based on their prospects, not just reluctance to realize a loss."]}
